Best RTX 4060 8GB Laptops in India: 1080p & 1440p Gaming Benchmarks

With 8GB of GDDR6 VRAM and full support for ray tracing, path tracing, and DLSS 3.5 ray reconstruction, the RTX 4060 is the undisputed champion for enthusiast 1080p and 1440p mobile gaming in India.

🎯 Quick Buyer Verdict

If your budget is ~₹92k, get the ASUS TUF A15. If your budget is ~₹1.05 Lakh, get the HP Omen 16 (240Hz QHD) or Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 (500-nit 2.5K screen).
